species.name: Crappie
why: Water 66°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 20–26 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 50 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 70 ft, so fish stay above it.

species.name: Largemouth bass
why: Water 66°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.

Northeast wind at 10 mph pushes bait onto the southwest shore: try the wind-blown banks.
